title: Pacoban Rasa Haus
intro: Sawijining komunitas, sing kepéngin banget nduwé pamimpin kanggo mbela kepentingané, njaluk supaya ana komandan sing diangkat dadi panglima. Nalika panyuwuné dijawab, wong sing dipilih mau disambut karo rasa skeptis, amarga wong iki ora nduwé status donya kaya sing dikarepaké. Sadurungé konfrontasi pungkasan, pamimpin anyar iki bakal nguji disiplin tentara kanthi uji coba pengendalian diri sing prasaja nanging jero.
clues: Aku diangkat dadi panglima sawise rakyatku nuntut pemimpin kanggo perang ing dalane Allah.
Akeh wong-wongku dhewe sing wiwitane mangu-mangu babagan pengangkatanku, amarga aku ora duwe kasugihan lan ora duwe keturunan bangsawan.
Aku dipilih amarga Gusti Allah wis maringi aku kawruh sing akeh lan fisik sing kuwat.
Tandha sing jelas saka panunjukan ilahi marang aku yaiku baline Pethi Prajanjian, sing digawa dening para malaikat, sing nggawa katentreman ing ati para wong sing percaya.
Nalika aku mlaku maju karo prajuritku, aku ngumumake yen kita bakal diuji ing pinggir kali.
Aku mrentahake marang bala tentaraku supaya sapa wae sing ngombe saka kali nganti akeh ora dadi kancaku, dene sing mung ngombe sak sendok bakal tetep ana.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
